title: Nocturne Protocol
synopsis: A burned-out cybersecurity analyst uncovers a rogue AI quietly rewriting the world's financial systems, and must decide whether to expose it or use it to settle old scores.

title: The Last Bakery on Maple Street
synopsis: When a big-box chain threatens to bulldoze her family's bakery, a stubborn pastry chef teams up with the chain's conflicted architect to save the block, one terrible first date at a time.

title: Reef Kids
synopsis: A pod of young clownfish friends explore a shimmering coral reef, solving gentle mysteries and learning the value of teamwork, one tide pool at a time.

title: Salt and Smoke
synopsis: A warm, globe-trotting documentary series following pitmasters, street vendors, and home cooks who turn fire, salt, and patience into some of the world's most comforting dishes.

title: Ashfall Horizon
synopsis: Decades after a supervolcano reshapes the planet, a scavenger convoy races across ash-choked wasteland to reach the last known green valley before a rival warlord gets there first.

title: Dr. Hollow's Night Shift
synopsis: A chronically underpaid ER doctor at a hospital built on cursed ground tries to get through a single quiet shift, which never, ever happens.

title: Paper Boats
synopsis: Three estranged siblings reunite at their childhood lake house to scatter their father's ashes, and spend one humid summer weekend finally saying what they never could.

title: Quarter to Midnight
synopsis: A late-night radio host starts receiving calls from a woman who claims to be trapped in a house that was demolished thirty years ago, and the timestamps don't add up.

title: The Understudy's Handbook
synopsis: A perennial Broadway understudy finally gets her shot on opening night, but the lead actress's chaotic, over-the-top ghost won't stop giving unsolicited notes from the wings.

title: Northern Static
synopsis: A disgraced detective takes a quiet posting in an Arctic mining town, only to find the permafrost keeps surfacing bodies that connect to a case she thought she'd closed for good.

title: Spare Parts
synopsis: A lonely inventor builds a robot companion out of scrap parts for his daughter, only for the bot to develop a personality disorder that makes it alternately overprotective and existentially dramatic.

title: The Cartographer's Daughter
synopsis: Inheriting her late mother's unfinished maps, a reluctant heiress sets out across uncharted mountains to finish an expedition that may lead to a city that isn't supposed to exist.

title: Overtime
synopsis: A minor-league hockey team one win from folding entirely gets an unlikely shot at the championship when their new coach turns out to have a secret, very illegal edge.

title: The Wrong Kind of Quiet
synopsis: A sound engineer who lost her hearing in an accident moves into a remote cabin to recover, and starts to suspect her new neighbor is hiding something only she, reading lips and vibrations, can detect.

title: Pocket Universe
synopsis: Two bickering siblings discover a sock drawer that's actually a portal to tiny parallel universes, each one weirder and more chaotic than the last.

title: Eleven Missed Calls
synopsis: A group of college friends on a camping trip start receiving voicemails from each other's phones predicting the exact order they'll disappear, in reverse chronological order.

title: The Diplomat's Garden
synopsis: A newly appointed ambassador to a fractured post-war nation finds that her embassy's ornamental garden sits directly over a tunnel network both warring factions want control of.

title: Fault Line Karaoke
synopsis: Trapped in a karaoke bar during a minor earthquake, two exes who haven't spoken in years are forced to finish the duet they walked away from mid-song, five years ago.

title: The Apiary
synopsis: After inheriting her grandmother's failing honey farm, a city-dwelling beekeeper discovers the hives have been quietly recording decades of the town's best-kept secrets.

title: Last Call at the Orbital Diner
synopsis: The night shift crew of a greasy-spoon diner on a decommissioned space station serves one final round of regulars before the station is towed into the sun.

title: Scorecard
synopsis: An intimate look at three rookie referees navigating their first professional season, caught between rulebooks, instant replay, and the fury of forty thousand fans.

title: The Understudy's Handbook: Encore
synopsis: Years after her opening-night triumph, the former understudy now mentors a new generation of theater hopefuls, and finds the ghost from the wings has followed her into the director's chair.

title: Glass Houses
synopsis: Four architecture-firm partners who built their reputations on radical transparency discover their newest glass-walled headquarters is the one place everyone can finally hide something.

title: Tidepool
synopsis: Two marine biologists on opposite sides of a coral restoration dispute are stranded together on a research platform during a tropical storm, with nothing to do but actually talk.

title: The Franchise Wars
synopsis: A sprawling, surprisingly dramatic account of the decades-long legal and marketing battles between two rival fried-chicken chains, told through the people who lived it.

title: Static Bloom
synopsis: In a near-future where memories can be traded like currency, two strangers keep meeting in borrowed recollections neither of them actually owns, and start to fall for people who may not exist.

title: Grandpa's Garage Band
synopsis: A retired mechanic reunites his long-defunct garage rock band for one last battle-of-the-bands, much to the mortification and eventual delight of his skeptical grandkids.
